a3eb081edddf1a71.notes:
- Fraudsters created convincing duplicate websites and WhatsApp advisory channels impersonating legitimate platforms
- Victims were promised pre-IPO allotments and guaranteed overseas tech stock allocations before withdrawals were frozen

- Red flags: requests to transfer investment funds into third-party current accounts rather than verified clearing corporation escrow accounts
